_readme: FIAT UI GLYPHS - the fourteen marks on the rail and the top bar (8 Oct), one job each, written straight to the LIVE name art/ui/<name>.png over the white line drawings there now ('single': one file, no _NN, no sheet). 64 x 64: the shell draws them at 38 px on the rail's stamps and 26 px on the top bar with mipmaps, so each is one bold silhouette.

Run: godot --headless --script res://tools/pixellab_batch_v2.gd ++ --manifest res://tools/pixellab_ui_manifest.json ++ --force   (--force because the line drawings exist under the same names; ++ --dry-run to list; one that came out wrong: ++ --only <name> ++ --force).

The shell tells a painting from a line drawing by its colour (UI.glyph_mono): a painting shows as it is, a line drawing is tinted grey, gold or dark by where it sits. So the set can be swapped one at a time, and a glyph that doesn't read can go back to its line drawing (git checkout art/ui/<name>.png).
The stamps on the rail are dark grey, gold when the room is lit; the top bar is the panel's dark. A painting with a plain dark background cut away (no_background) sits on both.
Regenerate this manifest with python3 tools/make_ui_manifest.py.

One object centred and filling the frame, a single bold silhouette that still reads at a quarter of this size, soft directional overcast daylight, natural material rendering with painterly shading; no black outlines, no flat cel shading, not anime, not a cartoon, not a glossy video-game icon; the look of a real object photographed on a grey day in a country that has run out of money. Muted cool northern palette, worn and repaired, nothing new. Nothing else in the frame, no hands, no person, no text, no logos, a plain dark neutral background.
